assessment.report:
# Documentation content placement: final scoped readiness

The user-approved bounded correction is implemented in existing shared authoring, ownership, execution and assignment templates plus team-core/team-doc-check/team-dev entrypoints and Docs Maintainer instructions. README remains a stable project entrypoint with useful concise summaries and links; workflow journals, detailed reproducible testing, authoritative stage results and readiness records reuse their designated existing documents. Existing alternative conventions remain valid; no fixed folder set, wholesale movement or duplicate authority is introduced.

Authorized documentation editing requires prompt evidence-backed corrections of related outdated, inaccurate, misplaced or duplicated active content within assigned ownership, preserving substance, references and historical/user acceptance evidence. Cross-owner or broader work requires bounded reassignment; substantive ambiguity, authority conflicts and disputed archival require user decisions. Read-only diagnosis reports findings without mutation. Lead assignments specify content responsibilities and closure checks inspect actual doc diffs, not merely changed filenames.

Lead inspected the original contracts, current README, architecture/release policy, canonical initial/final packet and final actual diff. The exact named Docs Maintainer implemented assigned instructions; Tester prepared the validated plan before writer release, completed source scenarios DP-01 through DP-07 and native validation plus four isolated validation/stage/documentation/fake-home installation suites, all exit0 with fixture cleanup. Reviewer independently reviewed the final source and scenarios, found no material defects, reran native package/packet validation and observed the initial governance review correctly fail STALE after changes. Lead reconciled all actual handles/selectors and reran package/packet validation after the final evidence append. Resolved inference identity/model is unconfirmed; source/tool expectations are not substituted for runtime identity.

Existing DOC-CONTRACT/ROUTING architecture remains adequate; no Blueprint amendment, structural refactor, rendered UI, applicable PRD or OpenSpec adoption is introduced. Runtime algorithms, readiness categories/schema/policyVersion and release VERSION remain unchanged; authoring/closure changes are recorded as Unreleased. Current authoring requirements apply regardless of older readiness records; this record is refreshed from actual inspection, not hash-only approval. Other inventoried documents remain outside scope and are not recertified.

Package/source checks do not establish real-agent E2E compliance or user acceptance. All planned runtime observations/manual checks remain pending in docs/verification/active/doc-content-placement.md; no automation exception or fabricated Red/manual pass is claimed. No business-project edits, actual installation, external services, commit or push occurred. Current governance pointers keep one review per scope and preserve superseded system-owned reviews in archive.
